description: This file contains driver implementation for the eSPI SAF (Serial Flash Access Function) on Microchip XEC chips, including configuration, initialization, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: mchp_saf_cs_descr_wr
methods.description: Write descriptor value to SAF chip select register.

methods.name: mchp_saf_poll2_mask_wr
methods.description: Write mask value to SAF poll register for specified chip select.

methods.name: mchp_saf_cm_prefix_wr
methods.description: Write prefix value to SAF continuous mode register for specified chip select.

methods.name: saf_protection_regions_init
methods.description: Initialize SAF flash protection regions for full flash access.

methods.name: qmspi_freq_div
methods.description: Calculate frequency divider for given frequency in Hz.

methods.name: qmspi_freq_div_from_mhz
methods.description: Calculate frequency divider from MHz value.

methods.name: saf_qmspi_init
methods.description: Re-initialize QMSPI for SAF hardware use.

methods.name: saf_flash_timing_init
methods.description: Initialize flash timing parameters.

methods.name: saf_dnx_bypass_init
methods.description: Disable DnX bypass feature.

methods.name: saf_init_erase_block_size
methods.description: Configure supported erase block sizes based on flash capabilities.

methods.name: get_erase_size_encoding
methods.description: Get encoding for requested erase size.

methods.name: check_ecp_access_size
methods.description: Validate requested EC portal access size.

methods.name: saf_ecp_access
methods.description: Perform EC portal access command (read, write, erase, RPMC).

methods.name: saf_xec_flash_read
methods.description: Read flash via SAF EC portal.

methods.name: saf_xec_flash_write
methods.description: Write flash via SAF EC portal.

methods.name: saf_xec_flash_erase
methods.description: Erase flash via SAF EC portal.

methods.name: espi_saf_xec_manage_callback
methods.description: Manage callbacks for SAF events.

methods.name: espi_saf_xec_activate
methods.description: Activate SAF hardware and start monitoring.

methods.name: espi_saf_done_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for SAF operation completion.

methods.name: espi_saf_err_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for SAF error events.
